shared_elements: low-relief carving on a weathered stone surface
horizontal band or register dividing the composition
museum display context with plain wall behind
justification: Both are upright weathered stone monuments bearing shallow relief that includes disc/circle elements and scroll-like curls organised loosely into horizontal zones, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a three-dimensionally shaped, dark, sparsely and faintly incised figure-like block with large blank areas, while B is a flat pale slab densely packed edge-to-edge with deeper, more legible figural and glyph-like carving in stacked registers, so the compositional density and manner of cutting are quite different.
